wikimedia_commons.source_file: File:1947 ROC claim line in Ladakh.jpg

attribution.title: 1947 ROC claim line in Ladakh
attribution.author: Republic of China
attribution.credit: https://www.nansha.org.cn/maps/3/1947_ROC_Map.jpg
attribution.description:
This extract from a 1947 map of the w:Republic of China (1912–1949) shows the border claimed against the Ladakh region of India. Though the map is of low resolution, it is possible to conclude that:
it cross the w:Demchok sector near the Chang La pass
includes the w:Spanggur Tso within Ladakh
dissects the w:Pangong Tso at its narrowest, i.e., near the w:Khurnak Fort
crosses the w:Chang Chenmo Valley at w:Lanak La
includes within Ladakh all the rivers that  drain into the w:Shyok River (including the w:Galwan River), and
crosses the Qaratagh range at the Karatagh Pass (taking the Qaratagh-su as the source of the w:Karakash River)
See Karackattu, Joe Thomas (2020). "The Corrosive Compromise of the Sino-Indian Border Management Framework: From Doklam to Galwan". Asian Affairs 51 (3): 590–604. DOI:10.1080/03068374.2020.1804726. ISSN 0306-8374.
